description.value: Cuckoo Trattoria & Pizzeria is a full-service Italian restaurant in the small Vancouver Island town of Coombs, led by Italian-born Head Chef Fausto Bellicini who blends traditional Italian technique with local west coast ingredients such as wild-caught salmon, locally sourced mussels, and foraged mushrooms. Wood-fired oven pizza is a centrepiece of the menu, and a forest-facing patio is open through the summer season. Situated on the Alberni Highway, it also functions as an events venue for weddings and larger gatherings.
